notes.title: Experience Enhancement Patch
notes.content:
New Features

Long-press an equipment slot on the equipment screen for 0.5 seconds or longer to lock or unlock it. Locked equipment cannot be equipped or be subject to batch enhancement, upgrading, or recycling, but can still be enhanced or upgraded manually.
Added Custom Enhancement, allowing players to filter and select target equipment for batch enhancement.
Added Custom Recycling, allowing players to filter and select target equipment for batch recycling.

notes.title: Regular Fixed Patch
notes.content:
Fixes

 Addressed an issue where laser weapons could penetrate monsters infinitely.
 Fixed a discrepancy where upgrade materials for randomly dropped gear versus crafted gear were inconsistent.
 Resolved a bug causing newly spawned monsters to inherit previous states instead of resetting.

Optimizations

 Further optimized performance issues.

notes.title: Regular Balance Patch
notes.content: Significantly increased the drop rates of teeth and brain matter from Stage 6 onwards.

notes.title: Regular Balance Patch
notes.content:
Slightly increased the difficulty of Stages 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.
 Significantly increased the difficulty of Stages 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10.

notes.title: Regular Fix Patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash when a vehicle was destroyed.

notes.title: Regular Update Patch
notes.content:
Fixed

 Fixed an issue where grade 1 and grade 2 missile weapons failed to fire, caused by recent performance optimizations.

Adjusted

 Adjusted difficulty balance between stages. Please note this will be frequently tuned over the next few weeks to prepare for the upcoming new map.

notes.title: Regular Update Patch
notes.content: Greatly optimized game performance!

notes.title: Fix Patch
notes.content: Fixed performance issues.

notes.title: Fix Patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue where Unique Weapons had incorrect quality ratings.

notes.title: Regular Update Patch
notes.content:
Update Notes

 Pre-Update: This patch lays the foundation for the upcoming "Unique Weapons" system and enables the drop of one unique weapon. If you're lucky, you can experience it early.
 Pre-Update: This update prepares the system for the upcoming DLC, though DLC content is not yet available.

Adjustments

 Adjusted the attack range of the Starry Sky V7's attack drone. Missiles now only target monsters (no longer fire at invalid targets).

notes.title: Minor Tuning Patch
notes.content: At the War Factory, if the player deconstructs non-weapon equipment, a random weapon type will be selected to upgrade the Brain Squeezer.

notes.title: Minor Tuning Patch
notes.content: Smoother monster spawns in mid-to-late game, creating a more satisfying and visually relaxing combat flow.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Update
notes.content:
Added

 Added the "Jumping Zombie" gene fragment to the Z-Virus.
 Added the "Non-perishable" gene fragment to the Z-Virus.

Adjusted

 Increased early-game pace: Monsters now spawn faster.
 Doubled tooth drop rate in the early game (including and before Stage 4).
 Base equipment drop rate increased by 60%.

Fixed

 Fixed an issue where the attack power value of vehicle-mounted weapons was displayed incorrectly.

notes.title: Regular Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
Fixed

 Fixed an issue where bonus attributes of dropped items were not affected by the Weapon Power Index.

Adjustments

 Increased the growth rate of the Current Dropped Equipment Power Index.
 The Current Dropped Equipment Power Index is now visible to players.
 Replaced the "Map" text with an icon.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Update
notes.content:
Added


 Increased randomness in equipment drops. Items now drop randomly between Common and Relic quality, and equipment stats also have random variation.
 The more equipment drops in the game, the stronger the equipment becomes. This means that even if a player crafts a max-tier item early in the game, max-tier items crafted later in the game will likely be stronger due to improved base power.

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the Fertilizer Plant upgrade "Worker Training" in Apocalypse Farm, where the cost deviated from the intended scaling curve.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Patch
notes.content:
Added

 Added a new Research Center: "Rice Yield Research Project".
 Added a new Research Center: "Farm Experience Research Project".
 Added a new Research Center: "Factory Experience Research Project".
 Added a new Research Center: "Land Experience Research Project".

Adjusted

 Significantly increased the effect of stage progression on Proteanium drop rate. Now, the drop rate increases by 20% per stage cleared (not per danger level), with additive calculation.
 Slightly increased the amount of Teeth dropped.
 Increased the base HP of monsters in stages 8, 9, and 10.
 Increased the base Attack Power of monsters in stages 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10.
 Greatly increased the drop amount of Brain Matter and Teeth from monsters in stages 7, 8, 9, and 10.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Patch
notes.content:
[Added]

 Added Apocalypse Farm building technology: Endorphin Sprinkler System
 Added Apocalypse Farm building technology: Employee Euphoria Analyzer

[Adjustments]

 Adjusted: The farm upgrade "Farm Manager" has been reclassified under Building Technologies
 Adjusted: The factory upgrade "Factory Manager" has been reclassified under Building Technologies

notes.title: Regular Incremental Patch
notes.content:
Added


 When hovering the mouse over the Brain Squeezer upgrade button, the current Brain Squeezer level and its damage bonus will be displayed.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Update
notes.content:
New Content


 Expanded the Apocalypse Farm gameplay by adding the Building Center tab. By demolishing old farms and fertilizer factories, players can obtain Farm Credits and Factory Credits. These credits can be used in the Building Center to purchase and upgrade building technologies.


Adjustments


 Brain matter will now prioritize upgrading the Bomber's Brain Booster Device, and will no longer accumulate due to slow consumption during upgrades.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Update
notes.content:
New vehicle: Starry Sky V7
Trait: Attack Drone
The vehicle is equipped with an integrated drone deployment and recovery platform, supporting the launch and retrieval of drones. The drones feature autonomous attack capabilities, capable of locking onto and engaging zombie targets. Their attack strength is determined by the firepower parameters of the third turret mounted on the vehicle.
New product in Apocalypse Farm: Proteanium Copia
Whenever a higher quality proteanium is dropped, additional excellent quality proteanium are also dropped.

notes.title: Regular Incremental Update
notes.content:
New Features

 Added the Brain Energy Booster — click and hold to accumulate energy, significantly enhancing the effect of the Brain Ejector. This device will play an increasingly important role in future updates. Stay tuned, players!
 The Doom Farm now offers a new product: Talent Tree Reset. After purchase, you can reset your talent points in the talent tree interface.

Adjustments & Improvements

 When critical hit rate exceeds 100%, multiple critical hits can now be triggered. For example, a 412% crit rate means your attack will land 4 guaranteed crits, plus a 12% chance for a 5th. The more crits per attack, the higher the damage multiplier — now scaling exponentially.
 Reduced Worker Training material cost from 10 to 1. Now, only 20 Super Yuaran Alloys are needed to max out training levels.
 Reduced experience requirements for plots, farms, and all chemical plants to 1/5 of the original amount, speeding up progression.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Farm Help Info Box was not displaying correctly.

notes.title: Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker DLC
notes.content:
Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker - Combat Train DLC
Welcome to the storm of steel and explosives! The "Combat  Train" DLC for Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker is now live, introducing three uniquely designed battle trains — Pioneer, Bomber, and Backer. These machines were not built for speed, but for obliterating everything that stands in your way!

Whether you're charging headfirst into battle or outmaneuvering enemies with tactical precision, the Combat Train DLC delivers the most intense combat experience yet. Each vehicle comes with an extremely powerful unique ability to help you dominate the battlefield.
Key Features:
Pioneer: The vanguard of frontline assaults, equipped with a mysterious gravity-controlling device — perfect for breaking through enemy defenses.

Bomber: Armed with a high-explosive bomb launcher, it excels at long-range destruction — built specifically to unleash chaos and devastation.

Backer: Fitted with auxiliary systems, it can boost allies' attacks and provide critical supply support — an indispensable asset in team battles.
Get the Backer for Free:
Even if you're not ready to purchase the full DLC, you can still claim one of these vehicles for free! Simply watch the official promotional video, enter the displayed gift code, and receive the Backer absolutely free — and experience the thrill of explosive warfare! (We will release the video in the coming days.)

notes.title: Major Version Update
notes.content:
Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker Major Version Update – Apocalypse Farm Launches!
Attention all brave adventurers and apocalypse survival experts! Are you ready to face unprecedented challenges and opportunities? Bomb Vehicle The Idle Clicker is thrilled to announce its major version update! The brand-new enhancement module—Apocalypse Farm—is officially launching today! This isn't just a simple patch; it's a revolutionary leap in post-apocalyptic survival, letting you experience the unique joys of "farming" while your war wagon roars across the wasteland!
Core Feature: Apocalypse Farm – New Life on the Wasteland
In the aftermath of the cataclysm, resources are scarce, but resourceful survivors always find a way. The all-new Apocalypse Farm system is here to transform your base!

Wasteland Cultivation: Players can now cultivate their own farms right at their base. Don't underestimate these humble crops! They're vital sustenance for survivors and can be traded for other essential supplies and goods!

Automated Idle Gameplay: Say goodbye to tedious repetition! Remember to upgrade your high-tech farm facilities—once set up, your "Auto-Seeders" and "Smart Harvesters" will work 24/7, generating resources non-stop, even while you're focused on intense combat. This is true idle gameplay, letting you grow stronger while you rest!

Tech Upgrades: Invest resources to upgrade your farm infrastructure! From fertilizers and seeds to expanding farmland and building fertilizer plants, each upgrade significantly boosts crop yield and rarity. Unlock the "Gene Mutation" technology to cultivate legendary Doomsday artifacts!

Other Adjustments:

Early-Game Pacing Adjustments: We've accelerated early-game resource accumulation and introduced earlier drops of AI Chip equipment, allowing players to unlock automated clicking functions sooner.

Vehicle Trait – Dr. Freeze Adjustment: Dr. Freeze's ability now applies to frozen zombies. However, freeze duration on Bosses is halved. With fast enough attack frequency, players can now achieve infinite freezing on regular zombies (Bosses are excluded).

Update now and enter your apocalypse farming era! The major update for Bomb Vehicle the Idle Clicker is live across all platforms. Will you continue to charge recklessly across the wasteland? Or settle down to become a shrewd farm master? Perhaps master both and become the ultimate apocalypse overlord? The choice is yours!

Drive your vehicle, sow hope, and reap the future! The Apocalypse Farm awaits—come claim your land!

notes.title: Routine Update
notes.content:
[olist]
UI Optimization: Added a "Cancel" button on the confirmation screen for returning to the base.
UI Optimization: Added a resource display area in the War Factory.
UI Optimization: On the vehicle purchase page, vehicle traits can now be viewed when checking vehicle information.
[/olist]

Adjusted Mechanic: Scientist training efficiency is now amplified based on the exponential investment factor.
Adjusted Mechanic: Vehicle upgrade experience becomes significantly smoother after level 1000.
The experience requirement scales gradually until 99,999 experience points are reached, at which point the experience multiplier reaches 1000x.
Vehicles can now smoothly level up to the 1 million level, where the experience multiplier reaches 1000x × 10.
At 2 million levels, the experience multiplier reaches 1000x × 20, and so on.
All experience increases between these levels are smooth and gradual.
Summary: Before reaching 1 million levels, the total required experience has been significantly reduced.

notes.content: New addition: a new SUV vehicle, the first vehicle in this game that comes with a summon. Hope you enjoy the gameplay!

notes.title: Minor Fix Patch
notes.content:
Fix: Resolved an issue where recycling repair device-type equipment would unintentionally boost machine gun weapon damage.
Now, recycling repair device-type equipment no longer has any effect.


Adjustment: Adjusted the experience growth curve for vehicles. 
- Experience requirements for levels 1 to 999 have been reduced.
- For levels 999 to 99,999, the required experience has been increased by 1000x the original amount.
- For levels above 99,999, the required experience has been further increased by 10x.

This change encourages players to use different vehicles in battle, allowing them to experience a variety of playstyles and quickly accumulate talent points.

notes.title: Minor Update Patch
notes.content:
Addition: Added auto-reset level functionality to Class 4 AI chips.
Auto-reset conditions:
1. The auto-reset level feature is in the On state;
2. If the current level exceeds 60 seconds, the danger level of this level will be reset to Level 1 (equivalent to starting from the base).


Fix: After updating the game, the language setting no longer defaults to English.
